This small plot is just 0.14 hectares and I grow something other than the main cereals here — it's not worth buying expensive chemical fertilizer for it, especially with prices being what they are. I'll put manure from around the homestead on it since I have that available, and I'll use seed I've saved myself like I always do. My wife and I can manage the work ourselves on a plot this size; maybe I'll call a neighbor for a day or two during the busiest time.
